_meta.independence_statement: Every expected answer herein is independently derived; no legacy system output was consulted (services/gochara_v3, services/w2g, pipeline/transit_search.py were never run or read for values). Swiss-derived numbers were computed directly with pyswisseph 2.10.03 against the sha256-verified .run/se1 files; synthetic numbers are hand-specified math documented case-by-case in WP2_FIXTURES.md.
_meta.chart_id_rule: All chart ids are synthetic wp2-synth-* ids. No real chart id appears anywhere in this file.

ephemeris_backend_record.retflag_note: 65602 = FLG_SIDEREAL(65536) + NONUT(64, added internally by Swiss for sidereal) + SWIEPH(2). F-14 gate retflag & 2 asserted on EVERY swe.calc_ut/swe.calc call that produced an expected value in this file; a Moshier fallback (retflag & 4) would have made the case NOT_RUN.

_meta.swiss_convention: swe.set_ephe_path('.run/se1'); swe.set_sid_mode(SIDM_LAHIRI); flags = FLG_SWIEPH | FLG_SIDEREAL (D-1); knots at swe.julday(y,m,d,12.0) for node sampling (noon-UT abscissa, F-15).

case_01_close_station_cubic.description: Synthetic cubic longitude curve with a station region crossing target degree 270.0 three times (direct -> retrograde -> direct). Hand-specified coefficients; roots solved analytically (factored form) and verified by bisection and numpy.roots. No ephemeris involved.
case_01_close_station_cubic.derivation: hand-specified + analytic/numeric root solve (numpy.roots, bisection; the two agree to 3.2e-12 days)

derivation_detail.f_over_0.001_polynomial: t^3 - 18t^2 + 99t - 162 (roots of f(t)=lambda(t)-270.0 exactly at t=3,6,9 by the factored form)
derivation_detail.extrema: f'(t)=0 at t = 6 +/- sqrt(3) = 4.267949 / 7.732051 days, deviations +0.0103923 / -0.0103923 deg (+/-37.4 arcsec) -- the 'close station': the body reverses only 37 arcsec from the target, far inside the 1.0 deg orb, so the orb is never vacated between roots
derivation_detail.orb_boundaries: |f|=1.0 -> t^3-18t^2+99t+838=0 (entry, t=-4.29991269688132) and t^3-18t^2+99t-1162=0 (exit, t=+16.29991269688132); each has exactly one real root (discriminant-checked numerically), verified by direct evaluation lambda(t)=269.0 / 271.0

expected.episode_pinning_rule: WP2 decision, pinned: one episode per root. Because the body never leaves the orb between roots, each episode's t_in/t_out are the orb boundaries clipped at the neighbouring roots: episode k spans [max(orb_entry, t_exact_{k-1}), min(orb_exit, t_exact_{k+1})]. Episode 2 (retrograde) therefore has t_in = t_exact of root 1 and t_out = t_exact of root 3.

case_02_true_node_excursion.description: TRUE node vs MEAN node sidereal separation over calendar 2026, sampled every 6 hours at noon-knot-compatible UT instants. Under the pinned mean-node convention (N-4a(b'')), the transiting node position used for every Rahu/Ketu contact is swe.MEAN_NODE; the true node's excursion is the wrong-answer detector.
case_02_true_node_excursion.derivation: computed directly with pyswisseph 2.10.03 against .run/se1 (checksums in _meta); FLG = FLG_SWIEPH|FLG_SIDEREAL, SIDM_LAHIRI, D-1

inputs.sampling: every 6 h (1465 samples; 6 h spacing catches the max of the quasi-monthly true-node oscillation to better than 15 arcsec)

derivation_detail.max_separation: max over samples of |lon_TRUE - lon_MEAN| (wrapped to [0,180]) = 1.7642302810 deg = 6351.229 arcsec
derivation_detail.cross_check: independent call path swe.calc at JD_ET = JD_UT + swe.deltat(JD_UT) at the same instant reproduces 6351.229011 arcsec (delta 0.000 arcsec)

expected.convention_pin: The fixture pins swe.MEAN_NODE (FLG_SIDEREAL, SIDM_LAHIRI) positions as the expected input set for all Rahu/Ketu contact solving. A kernel reporting node contacts against swe.TRUE_NODE positions is WRONG under convention N-4a(b''); an error of up to ~1.76 deg = 6351 arcsec at contact time is the demonstrated magnitude of the defect.

case_03_seam_tangency.description: Synthetic monotone arc split into two partitions with a contact falling exactly at the seam instant. Expected: exactly 1 episode, never zero, never duplicated.
case_03_seam_tangency.derivation: hand-specified linear arc; hand-computed contact instant

inputs.curve: lambda(t) = 270.0 + 0.1*(t - 5) degrees, t in days from 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z (direct motion, 0.1 deg/day)

derivation_detail.contact_instant: lambda = 270.5 -> t = 5 exactly -> 2026-03-06T00:00:00Z = the seam instant
derivation_detail.orb_span: orb 1.0 deg at 0.1 deg/day -> t_in = seam - 10 d = 2026-02-24T00:00:00Z, t_out = seam + 10 d = 2026-03-16T00:00:00Z (the orb straddles both partitions even though t_exact sits on the seam)

expected.attribution_rule_pinned: A contact whose t_exact equals a partition seam is attributed to the partition whose END it equals (partition A, end-closed). It must appear in exactly one partition: zero episodes (seam dropped as 'outside both') and two episodes (emitted once per partition) are both test failures.

case_04_horizon_edge_truncation.description: Start-inside and end-inside episodes at a horizon edge, including cases where t_exact lies OUTSIDE the horizon but the orb overlaps it: the episode is emitted truncated, never dropped. Hand-computed overlap intervals.
case_04_horizon_edge_truncation.derivation: hand-specified linear arcs; hand-computed orb entries/exits and overlap intervals

start_inside_exact_outside_before.derivation_detail: At horizon start lambda = 268.5 (0.5 deg inside the 1.0 deg orb). t_exact (lambda = 268.0) would be at t = -10 d = 2026-03-22T00:00:00Z, BEFORE the horizon. Orb exit (lambda = 269.0) at t = +10 d = 2026-04-11T00:00:00Z, inside the horizon.

expected.drop_is_failure: t_exact is outside the horizon but the orb overlaps it for 10.0 days; a truncated episode MUST be emitted. Dropping it, or emitting it with t_exact fabricated inside the horizon, is a test failure.

end_inside_exact_inside.derivation_detail: Orb entry (lambda = 269.0) at t = 25/3 d = 2026-04-09T08:00:00Z (inside horizon). t_exact (lambda = 268.0) at t = +25 d = 2026-04-26T00:00:00Z (inside). Orb exit (lambda = 267.0) would be at t = 125/3 d = 2026-05-12T16:00:00Z, BEYOND the horizon end.

expected.drop_is_failure: Truncated_at_horizon='end', t_out pinned to the horizon end exactly; the remaining 11.67 days of orb beyond the horizon are recorded as unsearched, never silently folded into t_out (H-3 discipline).

case_05_noon_midnight_epoch.description: F-15 trap: ephemeris_daily knots are at NOON UT. The Moon's sidereal longitude at 2026-06-15T12:00:00Z (correct noon-knot abscissa) vs 2026-06-15T00:00:00Z (midnight abscissa) differs by ~6.5 deg; a kernel consuming noon knots must treat the knot abscissa as noon.
case_05_noon_midnight_epoch.derivation: computed directly with pyswisseph 2.10.03 against .run/se1 (checksums in _meta); FLG = FLG_SWIEPH|FLG_SIDEREAL, SIDM_LAHIRI, D-1

cross_checks: swe.calc at JD_ET = JD_UT + swe.deltat (deltat = 0.0007968447 d) reproduces both longitudes to 0.000 arcsec (independent call path)

tropical-minus-ayanamsa path (FLG_SWIEPH tropical - get_ayanamsa_ut = 65.6223320 deg) agrees within 7.36 arcsec -- the expected nutation-in-longitude-of-date difference between the two sidereal paths (WP1_CONTRACTS.md §1 D-1 note)
derivation_detail.note_on_332arcsec: WP1_CONTRACTS.md §1 records a historical 'spurious 332.3 arcsec' from a midnight abscissa. The ACTUAL noon-vs-midnight lunar abscissa difference computed here is 27543.6 arcsec (~6.5 deg), the true magnitude of the F-15 trap for the Moon; the 332.3 arcsec historical figure is a different (smaller, case-specific) residual and is NOT reproduced by this 12-hour abscissa shift. The fixture pins the actual computed value.

expected.kernel_requirement: A kernel consuming the noon-knot substrate must treat each knot's abscissa as 12:00 UT. An off-by-12h abscissa for the Moon shifts positions by ~27544 arcsec, dwarfing every declared tolerance in WP1_CONTRACTS.md §9 (2-5 arcsec).

case_06_special_drishti_table.description: Per-graha special drishti angle table (BPHS ch.26 per WP1_CONTRACTS.md §7 doctrine note) with N-14: Rahu and Ketu cast NO drishti at all, not even the 7th -- while remaining valid conjunction/ingress/kakshya/return agents AND targets.
case_06_special_drishti_table.derivation: hand-specified (doctrine table pinned by WP1_CONTRACTS.md §7 and §2.2 N-14 note)

rahu_ketu_relation_set.note: Nodes remain full gochara agents and targets (conjunction, ingresses, kakshya-cell crossing, returns to/from them); only drishti_contact is excluded. Any drishti_contact episode with body or target Rahu/Ketu is a test failure (N-14; supersedes the served SPECIAL_DRISHTI_DEG entries for the nodes, F-29).

case_12_plateau_ties.description: Synthetic daily lambda(t) series with a flat plateau at the maximum spanning k=4 consecutive days. Peak detection must handle the tie deterministically; with H-5 (no cap) all admitted peaks persist.
case_12_plateau_ties.derivation_detail: Days 0-11 ramp 0.5 -> 0.94; days 12-15 plateau at exactly 1.0; days 16-29 ramp down. max = 1.0 attained at day indices 12,13,14,15 (dates 2026-01-13 .. 2026-01-16).

expected.tie_break_rule_pinned: ALL tied maxima are admitted with the SAME rank (no first-day-wins, no arbitrary single pick, no drop of the 'duplicate' days). The plateau contributes 4 admitted peaks, each carrying its own date and sharing rank 1.
expected.h5: With the H-5 fix (no fixed cap on stored peaks per era per decade), all 4 admitted peaks persist in storage; trimming, if any, happens only at serve time.
